source.name: St. Louis CITY SC – 'Keeping Our City Healthy: St. Louis CITY SC Welcomes BJC Healthcare and Washington University Orthopedics As Founding Sponsors'
source.quote: As part of the new relationship, BJC will be represented on the First Team jersey’s right sleeve, and on the front of the training and academy team jerseys.
source.note: The 2022 club announcement that put BJC on the right sleeve; For Soccer's 2026 MLS jersey sponsor review lists BJC Healthcare as St. Louis City's right-sleeve partner again in 2026.

summary: All MLS clubs wear Adidas; Apple TV is on the left sleeve of every kit. Purina fronts the jersey and BJC HealthCare sits on the right sleeve.
